lyrics.original:
सुन्दर सुन्दर विनायक
शुभ मंगल दायक विनायक
विघ्न कोटि हर विमल गजानन
सकल विघ्न हर साई गजानन
ईश्वरी नन्दन पार्थी गजानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Sundara Sundara Vinayaka
Shubha Mangala Dayaka Vinayaka
Vighna Koti Hara Vimala Gajanana
Sakala Vighna Hara Sai Gajanana
Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Ganesha who is very beautiful, who bestows everything good and auspicious. He is the remover of millions of obstacles that come in our way. He is the elephant-faced son of Parvathi and is verily Lord Sai who resides in Parthi.

lyrics.original:
दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
अहल्योद्धारक राम शाप विमोचन राम
शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lyrics.transliteration:
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama
Ahalyodharaka Rama Shaapa Vimochana Rama
Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama
lyrics.translation: Glory to Thee, O Lord Rama, the darling son of King Dasharatha, You are an ocean of compassion and the Crown Jewel of the Raghu Dynasty. You are the saviour of Ahalya from the curse that had turned her into a stone. You are Lord Sathya Sai, the indweller of hearts, with Shirdi and Parthi as Your supreme abodes.

lines.original: दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
lines.transliteration: Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama

lines.original: रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama

lines.original: शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama

lyrics.original:
सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
परम पवित्रम् पावन चरणम्
कलिमल दहनम् श्री गुरु चरणम्
भव भय नाशन दुरित निवारण
पार्थी पुरीश्वर पंकज चरणम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam
Parama Pavitram Pavana Charanam
Kalimala Dahanam Sri Guru Charanam
Bhava Bhaya Nashana Duritha Nivarana
Parthi Pureeshwara Pankaja Charanam
lyrics.translation: Meditate incessantly upon the most holy and auspicious Lotus Feet of Lord Sathya Sai. His feet are supremely pure and sacred. They burn away the sins of this Kali age. They destroy the fear of worldly existence and remove all afflictions. Worship the lotus feet of the Lord of Parthi.

lines.original: सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
lines.transliteration: Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam

lyrics.original:
कोटि प्रणाम शत कोटि प्रणाम
हे दीन नाथ साई राम
तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
पार्थी पुरी के साई गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Koti Pranam Shata Koti Pranam
Hey Deena Natha Sai Ram
Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar
Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal
Parthi Puri Ke Sai Gopal
lyrics.translation: Many repeated salutations to You Lord Sai, the refuge of the forlorn. You are the incarnation of our age, born for the devotees. You are the son of Nanda, the blissful one. You are Sai Gopala residing at Parthi.

lines.original: तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar

lines.original: तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal

lyrics.original:
मनसा भजोरे गुरु चरणम्
दुस्तर भव सागर तरणम्
गुरु महाराज गुरु जय जय
साई नाथ गुरु जय जय
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
अरुणाचल शिव अरुणाचल शिव
lyrics.transliteration:
Manasa Bhajorey Guru Charanam
Dusthara Bhava Sagara Tharanam
Guru Maharaj Guru Jai Jai
Sai Natha Guru Jai Jai
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva
lyrics.translation: O mind, worship at the feet of the Guru. Take refuge under His feet which enables us to cross the unconquerable ocean of life. Victory to the great Guru, victory to Lord Sai Natha. Chant Om Namah Shivaya, salutations to the Lord of Arunachala.

lines.original: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
lines.transliteration: Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya

lyrics.original:
अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
माता माता माता जगत् जननी
जगत् जननी शुभ कारिणी
साई जगन्माता
सत्य साई जगन्माता
lyrics.transliteration:
Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani
Mata Mata Mata Jagat Janani
Jagat Janani Shubha Karini
Sai Jaganmata
Sathya Sai Jaganmata
lyrics.translation: Worship the auspicious Mother of the Universe, Mother Sai who has an enchanting face with a charming smile. She is the Mother of the world, the bestower of auspiciousness. Sathya Sai is the Mother of the entire creation.

lines.original: अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
lines.transliteration: Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani

lyrics.original:
पवन सुत हनुमान की जय
सीता पति रामचन्द्र की जय
पराक्रम अंजनेय की जय
पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lyrics.transliteration:
Pavana Sutha Hanuman Ki Jai
Sita Pathi Ramachandra Ki Jai
Parakrama Anjaneya Ki Jai
Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai
lyrics.translation: Victory to Hanuman, the son of the wind God. Victory to the chosen Lord of Sita, Lord Ramachandra. Victory to the mighty son of Anjana Devi. Victory to the Lord of Parthi, Sai Nath.

lines.original: पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lines.transliteration: Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
अयोध्या विहारी श्री राम राम राम
द्वारका विहारी श्री कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण
सप्तगिरि विहारी गोविन्द गोविन्द
निज भक्त हृदय विहारी श्री साई नाथ देव
lyrics.transliteration:
Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama
Dwaraka Vihari Sri Krishna Krishna Krishna
Saptagiri Vihari Govinda Govinda
Nija Bhaktha Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sai Natha Deva
lyrics.translation: This bhajan celebrates the divine across sacred locations. It invokes Lord Rama who resides in Ayodhya, Lord Krishna in Dwaraka, and Lord Govinda in the seven hills (Tirumala). It culminates in honoring Sai as the divine Lord who dwells within the hearts of devoted ones.

lines.original: अयोध्या विहारी श्री राम राम राम
lines.transliteration: Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama

lines.original: द्वारका विहारी श्री कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण
lines.transliteration: Dwaraka Vihari Sri Krishna Krishna Krishna

lines.original: निज भक्त हृदय विहारी श्री साई नाथ देव
lines.transliteration: Nija Bhaktha Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sai Natha Deva

lyrics.original:
जगत्पते हरि साई गोपाला
जगदोद्धार साई नन्दलाला
मथुराधिपते कृष्ण गोपाला
मधुर मधुर हे गान विलोल
जगदोद्धार साई नन्दलाला
साई नन्दलाला जय जय गोपाला
lyrics.transliteration:
Jagatpathey Hari Sai Gopala
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Mathuradhipathey Krishna Gopala
Madhura Madhura Hey Gaana Vilola
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Sai Nandalala Jai Jai Gopala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Gopala (Krishna), the Lord and sustainer of the Universe. Victory to Lord Krishna, the King of Mathura, the patron of sweet music and the son of Nanda. Victory to Lord Sai who is verily Lord Krishna.

lyrics.original:
ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय नन्दन साई जय जग वन्दन
रत्नाकर कुल भूषण राजीव नयन नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण
lyrics.transliteration:
Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Sai Jaya Jaga Vandana
Ratnakara Kula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics.translation: O Lord Sai, You are the beloved son of Mother Eshwaramba. You are worshipped by the whole world. You are the jewel of the Ratnakara clan, with eyes as beautiful as the lotus. O Lord Sai, You are verily Lord Hari Narayana.

lines.original: ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय नन्दन साई जय जग वन्दन
lines.transliteration: Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Sai Jaya Jaga Vandana

lines.original: रत्नाकर कुल भूषण राजीव नयन नारायण
lines.transliteration: Ratnakara Kula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana Narayana

lines.original: नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
lines.transliteration: Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana

lyrics.original:
अल्लाह भजो मौलाह भजो हे अल्लाह साई भगवान
राम भजो हे कृष्ण भजो हे राम कृष्ण भगवान
नानक भजो गौतम भजो हे बुद्ध साई भगवान
येसु भजो जरथुस्त्र भजो हे महावीर भगवान
साई भजो शिर्डी साई भजो हे शिर्डी साई भगवान
सत्य भजो सत्य साई भजो हे सत्य साई भगवान
lyrics.transliteration:
Allah Bhajo Maulah Bhajo Hey Allah Sai Bhagawan
Ram Bhajo Hey Krishna Bhajo Hey Rama Krishna Bhagawan
Nanak Bhajo Gautam Bhajo Hey Buddha Sai Bhagawan
Yesu Bhajo Zohrashtra Bhajo Hey Mahavir Bhagawan
Sai Bhajo Shirdi Sai Bhajo Hey Shirdi Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Bhajo Sathya Sai Bhajo Hey Sathya Sai Bhagawan
lyrics.translation: Chant the divine names of the Lord across all faiths — Allah, Rama, Krishna, Guru Nanak, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavir, Shirdi Sai and Sathya Sai. The song celebrates the universal spirituality that unites all faith traditions in worship of the one Divine.

lines.original: येसु भजो जरथुस्त्र भजो हे महावीर भगवान
lines.transliteration: Yesu Bhajo Zohrashtra Bhajo Hey Mahavir Bhagawan

lyrics.original:
भोला भण्डारी बाबा शिव शिव शिव साई बाबा
अनाथ रक्षक दीन दयाला पतित पावन साई बाबा
योगेश्वर साई मुरारी योगेश्वर हे त्रिपुरारी
नित्यानन्द ब्रह्मानन्द प्रेमानन्द साई बाबा
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba
Anatha Rakshaka Deena Dayala Patitha Pavana Sai Baba
Yogeshwara Sai Murari Yogeshwara Hey Tripurari
Nithyananda Brahmananda Premananda Sai Baba
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai Baba, easily pleased and a treasure of mercy and prosperity, is the protector of orphans and the refuge of the destitute. He is honored as the Lord of Yogis, as Sai Murari (Krishna), and as Tripurari (Shiva), the embodiment of eternal bliss and divine love.

lines.original: भोला भण्डारी बाबा शिव शिव शिव साई बाबा
lines.transliteration: Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba

lines.original: अनाथ रक्षक दीन दयाला पतित पावन साई बाबा
lines.transliteration: Anatha Rakshaka Deena Dayala Patitha Pavana Sai Baba

lines.original: योगेश्वर साई मुरारी योगेश्वर हे त्रिपुरारी
lines.transliteration: Yogeshwara Sai Murari Yogeshwara Hey Tripurari

lyrics.original:
साई नाथ दीन नाथ ब्रह्म रूप सद्गुरु
निराकार हे आकार सत्य साई सद्गुरु
ओंकार सद्गुरु निर्विकार सद्गुरु
निर्विकार सद्गुरु ओंकार सद्गुरु
माता पिता सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Natha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Sadguru
Nirakara Hey Akara Sathya Sai Sadguru
Omkara Sadguru Nirvikara Sadguru
Nirvikara Sadguru Omkara Sadguru
Mata Pitha Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru
lyrics.translation: This devotional hymn honors Sai as the Supreme Guru, protector of the weak and the downtrodden. It celebrates Sai's nature as both formless and embodied in divine form, references the primordial sound 'Om,' and concludes by acknowledging Sai as mother, father and our everything.

lines.original: साई नाथ दीन नाथ ब्रह्म रूप सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Sai Natha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Sadguru

lines.original: निराकार हे आकार सत्य साई सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Nirakara Hey Akara Sathya Sai Sadguru

lines.original: माता पिता सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Mata Pitha Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru

lyrics.original:
गरुड वाहन नारायण
हे शेष शयन नारायण
श्री लक्ष्मी रमण नारायण
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नारायण
lyrics.transliteration:
Garuda Vahana Narayana
Hey Shesha Shayana Narayana
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Narayana, who is the beloved of His consort Goddess Lakshmi, whose vehicle is Garuda, who sleeps on the serpent Adi Sesha, and who is also known as Hari.

lyrics.original:
गंगा जटाधर गौरी शंकर गिरिजा मनो रमण
जय मृत्युंजय महादेव महेश्वर मंगल शुभ चरण
नन्दि वाहन नाग भूषण
निरुपम गुण सदन
नटन मनोहर नीलकंठ साई
नीरज दल नयन
lyrics.transliteration:
Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana
Jaya Mruthyunjaya Mahadeva Maheshwara Mangala Shubha Charana
Nandi Vahana Naga Bhooshana
Nirupama Guna Sadana
Natana Manohara Neelakanta Sai
Neeraja Dala Nayana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Shiva, who bears the sacred Ganges in his matted hair and is the consort of Goddess Girija. Victory to the conqueror of death, the great Lord Maheshwara whose feet bestow auspiciousness. He rides the bull Nandi, is adorned with serpents, and is an embodiment of unparalleled virtues — the enchanting cosmic dancer with a blue throat, identified with Sai.

lines.original: गंगा जटाधर गौरी शंकर गिरिजा मनो रमण
lines.transliteration: Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana

lines.original: जय मृत्युंजय महादेव महेश्वर मंगल शुभ चरण
lines.transliteration: Jaya Mruthyunjaya Mahadeva Maheshwara Mangala Shubha Charana

lyrics.original:
गोविन्द बोलो गोपाल बोलो
राम राम बोलो हरि नाम बोलो
अल्लाह साई येसु नानक
जरथुस्त्र महावीर बुद्ध नाम बोलो
ये नाम सारे हैं जीवन सहारे
परमानन्द के ये खोलते हैं द्वारे
जो नाम चाहो वो नाम बोलो
प्रेम से बोलो भाव से बोलो
lyrics.transliteration:
Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
Ram Ram Bolo Hari Naam Bolo
Allah Sai Yesu Nanak
Zohrashtra Mahavira Buddha Naam Bolo
Yeh Naam Saarey Hai Jeevan Saharey
Paramananda Ke Yeh Kholtey Hai Dwarey
Jo Naam Chaho Woh Naam Bolo
Prem Se Bolo Bhaav Se Bolo
lyrics.translation: Chant the sacred names — Govinda, Gopala, Rama, Hari, Allah, Sai, Yesu, Nanak, Zoroaster, Mahavira and Buddha. These names sustain life's journey and open doors to supreme bliss. Choose whichever name resonates with you and recite it with love and devotion.

lines.original: राम राम बोलो हरि नाम बोलो
lines.transliteration: Ram Ram Bolo Hari Naam Bolo

lines.original: ये नाम सारे हैं जीवन सहारे
lines.transliteration: Yeh Naam Saarey Hai Jeevan Saharey

lines.original: जो नाम चाहो वो नाम बोलो
lines.transliteration: Jo Naam Chaho Woh Naam Bolo

lyrics.original:
श्रीनिवास वेङ्कटेश श्रित जन परिपाल सायीश
तिरुमल गिरि वास गोविन्द
गरुड वाहन गोविन्द गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द श्रीनिवास गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द शिर्डी वास गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द पार्थी वास गोविन्द
lyrics.transliteration:
Srinivasa Venkatesha Shritha Jana Paripala Sayeesha
Tirumala Giri Vasa Govinda
Garuda Vahana Govinda Govinda
Govinda Govinda Srinivasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Shirdi Vasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Parthi Vasa Govinda
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Srinivasa, Lord Venkatesha (names of Lord Vishnu) and Lord Sayeesha who protects all those who have surrendered to Him. Praise to Lord Govinda who resides in the Tirumala hills, who rides the eagle Garuda, and who manifests in Shirdi and Parthi.

lines.original: श्रीनिवास वेङ्कटेश श्रित जन परिपाल सायीश
lines.transliteration: Srinivasa Venkatesha Shritha Jana Paripala Sayeesha

lyrics.original:
भजरे राम चरण सततं भजरे
भजरे जानकी जीवन रामम्
भजरे रामम् भद्राचल रामम्
भजरे पावन तारक नामम्
भजरे श्री राम रामेति रामम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhajarey Rama Charan Satatam Bhajarey
Bhajarey Janaki Jeevana Ramam
Bhajarey Ramam Bhadrachala Ramam
Bhajarey Pavana Taraka Naamam
Bhajarey Sri Rama Ramethi Ramam
lyrics.translation: Constantly chant and meditate upon the Lotus Feet of Lord Rama. Pray to Lord Rama, the very life of Janaki and the resident of Bhadrachala. Chant His sacred name that purifies and ferries us across the ocean of worldly existence.

lyrics.original:
गिरिधर गोविन्द गोपाल घन श्याम नन्दलाल
मन मोहन मधुसूदन हे माधव
दामोदर जनार्दन मुरलीधर मन मोहन
नमो साई नारायणाय नमो सत्य नारायणाय
lyrics.transliteration:
Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala
Mana Mohana Madhusudhana Hey Madhava
Damodara Janardhana Muralidhara Mana Mohana
Namo Sai Narayanaya Namo Sathya Narayanaya
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Krishna — the lifter of Govardhana mountain (Giridhara), the cowherd (Govinda), protector of cows (Gopala), the dark-hued one (Ghana Shyama), beloved son of Nanda. He is the enchanting one (Mana Mohana), slayer of the demon Madhu (Madhusudhana), the bearer of the flute (Muralidhara), and protector of devotees (Janardhana). Salutations to Sai who is verily Narayana, the embodiment of divine truth.

lines.original: गिरिधर गोविन्द गोपाल घन श्याम नन्दलाल
lines.transliteration: Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala

lines.original: नमो साई नारायणाय नमो सत्य नारायणाय
lines.transliteration: Namo Sai Narayanaya Namo Sathya Narayanaya

lyrics.original:
प्रेममयी साई मां ज्ञानमयी साई मां
जय मां जय मां जय मां
शिव शक्ति रूपिणी साई मां
सदानन्द रूपिणी साई मां
परब्रह्म रूपिणी साई मां
तुम ही मोक्ष प्रदायिनी मां
lyrics.transliteration:
Premamayi Sai Ma Gnanamayi Sai Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Shiva Shakthi Roopini Sai Ma
Sadananda Roopini Sai Ma
Parabrahma Roopini Sai Ma
Tum Hi Moksha Pradayini Ma
lyrics.translation: Victory to Mother Sai — embodiment of love and wisdom, ever in a state of bliss. You are Shiva and Shakti united in one form, the supreme consciousness incarnate, and the bestower of liberation upon all who surrender to You.

lines.original: प्रेममयी साई मां ज्ञानमयी साई मां
lines.transliteration: Premamayi Sai Ma Gnanamayi Sai Ma

lines.original: जय मां जय मां जय मां
lines.transliteration: Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma

lyrics.original:
प्रणमामि श्री दुर्गे साई नारायणी
जय जगदम्बे देवी भवानी
जय महिषासुर संहारिणी महामाया दुख हारिणी
lyrics.transliteration:
Pranamami Sri Durge Sai Narayani
Jaya Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
Jaya Mahishasura Samhaarini Mahamaya Dukha Haarini
lyrics.translation: We offer our obeisance to You, Mother Durga — Sister of Vishnu, Mother of the Universe, and Devi Bhavani. Glory to the destroyer of the demon Mahishasura (the ego), the bearer of the great cosmic illusion, and the remover of all sorrow.

lines.original: जय महिषासुर संहारिणी महामाया दुख हारिणी
lines.transliteration: Jaya Mahishasura Samhaarini Mahamaya Dukha Haarini

lyrics.original:
प्रेम ईश्वर है ईश्वर प्रेम है
हर धड़कन में साई समा है ईश्वर प्रेम है
राम रहीम कृष्ण करीम
जरथुस्त्र येसु नानक
कोई भी नाम जपोरे मनुवा ईश्वर प्रेम है
lyrics.transliteration:
Prem Eshwar Hai Eshwar Prem Hai
Har Dhadkan Mey Sai Sama Hai Eshwar Prem Hai
Ram Rahim Krishna Karim
Zohrashtra Yesu Nanak
Koi Bhi Naam Japorey Manuva Eshwar Prem Hai

(Japanese verse)
Ai wa Kami, Kami wa Ai
Sai wa Ibuki, Kami wa Ai
Namu Amida, Iesu Sai
Amaterasu, Kannon Sai
Ikanaru Mina wo Tonaete mo, Kami wa Ai
lyrics.translation: God is Love and Love is God. Sai is the indweller of every heartbeat, reminding us that God is Love. Worship any divine name — Rama, Rahim, Krishna, Karim, Zoroaster, Jesus or Nanak — for all names and forms are love and only love.

lines.original: प्रेम ईश्वर है ईश्वर प्रेम है
lines.transliteration: Prem Eshwar Hai Eshwar Prem Hai

lyrics.original:
साई बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
शिर्डी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
पार्थी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
Shirdi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
Parthi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
lyrics.translation: The nectarine words of wisdom and the melodies that flow from Sai Baba confer infinite supreme bliss. Sai Baba's song is sweet and gives bliss — the Lord of Shirdi and the Lord of Parthi are one and the same, the embodiment of nectar-sweet joy.

lines.original: साई बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lines.original: शिर्डी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lines.original: पार्थी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Parthi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lyrics.original:
चित्त चोर यशोदा के बाल
नवनीत चोर गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल गोवर्धनधर गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Chitha Chora Yashoda Ke Bal
Navaneetha Chora Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gopal Govardhanadhara Gopal
lyrics.translation: O Lord Gopala, the beloved Prince of Mother Yashoda — captivator of devotees' hearts and stealer of butter from the Gopis. Chant the name of Govardhanadhara Gopal who held aloft the Govardhana mountain to shelter the villagers from torrential rain.

lyrics.original:
गुरु महिमा गाओ सद्गुरु साई अनन्त गुरु
ब्रह्मानन्द आनन्द गुरु
सर्व धर्म सत्य साई गुरु
साई गुरु सत्य साई गुरु
गुरु के वाणी गाओ
lyrics.transliteration:
Guru Mahima Gao Sadguru Sai Anantha Guru
Brahmananda Ananda Guru
Sarva Dharma Sathya Sai Guru
Sai Guru Sathya Sai Guru
Guru Ke Vani Gao
lyrics.translation: Sing about the greatness of the eternal, universal and ever-blissful teacher, Sathya Sai who loves all religions. He is the truth, knowledge and bliss.

lines.original: गुरु महिमा गाओ सद्गुरु साई अनन्त गुरु
lines.transliteration: Guru Mahima Gao Sadguru Sai Anantha Guru

title: Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
वीर धीर शूर हनुमान की जय
पवन पुत्र अंजनेय हनुमान की जय
सदा राम नाम जपत हनुमान की जय
राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम
सीता शोक नाश कारण हनुमान की जय
lyrics.transliteration:
Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai
Pavana Putra Anjaneya Hanuman Ki Jai
Sada Rama Naama Japata Hanuman Ki Jai
Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Ram
Sita Shoka Nasha Kaarana Hanuman Ki Jai
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Hanuman, the one of valor, courage, strength, son of Pavan (the wind god) and Anjana Devi. Victory to the one who chants Lord Rama's name incessantly and who is responsible for the removal of Mother Sita's sorrow.

lines.original: वीर धीर शूर हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: पवन पुत्र अंजनेय हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Pavana Putra Anjaneya Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: सदा राम नाम जपत हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Sada Rama Naama Japata Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: सीता शोक नाश कारण हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Sita Shoka Nasha Kaarana Hanuman Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
हर शिव शंकर शशांक शेखर
हर भम् हर भम् भम् भम् बोलो
भव भयंकर गिरिजा शंकर
धिमि धिमि धिमि थक नर्तन केलो
lyrics.transliteration:
Hara Shiva Shankara Shashankha Shekara
Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo
Bhava Bhayankara Girija Shankara
Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Thaka Narthana Kelo
lyrics.translation: Chant the name of Lord Shiva, dancing to the rhythm of drums. Shankara, Lord of Girija, destroys the fear of the cycle of birth and death.

lines.original: हर भम् हर भम् भम् भम् बोलो
lines.transliteration: Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo

lines.original: धिमि धिमि धिमि थक नर्तन केलो
lines.transliteration: Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Thaka Narthana Kelo

lyrics.original:
श्रीकरी कृपाकरी क्षेमंकरी सायीश्वरी
शंकरी अभयंकरी शुभंकरी सायीश्वरी
ताण्डवकेलि प्रियकरी भैरवी प्रलयंकरी
सर्वेश्वरी सुन्दरी दयाकरी महेश्वरी
lyrics.transliteration:
Srikari Krupakari Kshemankari Sayeeshwari
Shankari Abhayankari Shubhankari Sayeeshwari
Tandavakeli Priyakari Bhairavi Pralayankari
Sarveshwari Sundari Dayakari Maheshwari
lyrics.translation: Glory be to the beautiful, compassionate and all pervading goddess Parvathi, the consort of Shankara (Shiva), the one who bestows auspiciousness, who looks after the welfare of devotees, who bestows fearlessness and who is fond of the 'Tandava' dance.

lyrics.original:
लम्बोदर गणनाथ गजानन पार्वती नन्दन शुभानन
पशुपति तनय सिद्धि विनायक
प्रणवाकार शम्भो नन्दन
पार्थी पुरीश पाहि गजानन
हे शिव नन्दन शुभानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Lambodhara Gananatha Gajanana Parvathi Nandana Shubhanana
Pashupathi Tanaya Siddhi Vinayaka
Pranavakaara Shambho Nandana
Parthi Pureesha Paahi Gajanana
Hey Shiva Nandana Shubhanana
lyrics.translation: Protect me Lord Ganesha, the Lord of Ganaas, who has an elephant head and is the big bellied son of Mother Parvathi and Lord Shiva. You are the one who embodies the sacred Om and who is verily Sai, the Lord of Parthi.

lines.original: लम्बोदर गणनाथ गजानन पार्वती नन्दन शुभानन
lines.transliteration: Lambodhara Gananatha Gajanana Parvathi Nandana Shubhanana

lyrics.original:
भगवान भगवान पतित पावन राम
दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान
दीन दयालु परम कृपालु रक्षा करो भगवान
साई कृपा करो भगवान
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhagawan Bhagawan Patitha Pavana Ram
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan
Deena Dayalu Parama Krupalu Raksha Karo Bhagawan
Sai Krupa Karo Bhagawan
lyrics.translation: O Lord Sai, chanting Your name purifies the downtrodden. O the ever merciful and compassionate Lord, please shower Your grace and protect us.

lines.original: दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान
lines.transliteration: Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan

lines.original: दीन दयालु परम कृपालु रक्षा करो भगवान
lines.transliteration: Deena Dayalu Parama Krupalu Raksha Karo Bhagawan

lyrics.original:
रघुकुल भूषण राजीव नयन
ईश्वराम्बा नन्दन सत्य साई राम
जानकी वल्लभ लावण्य राम
निरुपम सुन्दर सुगुणाभि राम
प्रशान्ति निलय पावन नाम
जय जय राम प्रभु साई राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Raghukula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana
Eshwaramba Nandana Sathya Sai Rama
Janaki Vallabha Lavanya Rama
Nirupama Sundara Sugunabhi Rama
Prashanthi Nilaya Pavana Naama
Jaya Jaya Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
lyrics.translation: Glory to the jewel of the Raghu dynasty, the lotus-eyed Lord Rama. He is none other than the darling son of Mother Eshwaramba, Lord Sathya Sai. The beloved of Janaki (Sita), the exquisitely handsome Lord Rama, is beautifully-complexioned and the most virtuous. Victory to Lord Rama, who is verily our Lord Sai Rama, of the Holy abode, Prashanthi Nilayam.

lines.original: जय जय राम प्रभु साई राम
lines.transliteration: Jaya Jaya Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
